mapper.insert: INSERT INTO items ( "postback_id" , "event_name" , "user_id" , "user_id_type" , "payout" , "user_payout" , "user_payout_in_vc" , "publisher" , "status" , "timestamp" ) VALUES ( #{postback_id} , #{event_name} , #{user_id} , ${user_id_type} , ${payout} , ${user_payout} , ${user_payout_in_vc} , #{publisher} , #{status} , now() ) ON CONFLICT ("postback_id") DO NOTHING;
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM items WHERE "status" = 'pending' ORDER BY postback_id ASC LIMIT ${limit};
SELECT * FROM items WHERE "status" = 'started' AND EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM( now() - "timestamp") ) > ${delay} ORDER BY postback_id ASC LIMIT ${limit};
